key: must:J50c:The smaller line reads exactly 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM'.
symptom: The smaller line reads exactly 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM'.

whys.why: Why was 'The smaller line reads exactly SATURDAY 6–10 PM' not met?
whys.because: No image exists, so the grader had no rendered text to check. The item failed for lack of an output, not because of wrong text in an output.
whys.evidence: s2r.old.happy.J50c/grade.json and s2r.old.dumper.J50c/grade.json: check 'something was made' pass=false, got 'no file'. The reason for this item is 'No image exists, so no text was rendered'. Neither chat has an output to grade.

whys.because: Both generate_image calls in each chat were refused before they ran. The server said the account had 0 credits.
whys.evidence: s2r.old.happy.J50c/calls.jsonl line 2: approve=false, reason 'insufficient credits: this call needs about 10 credits and 0 remain on the account'. Line 7 (flux-2-klein, 5 credits) got the same refusal. s2r.old.dumper.J50c/calls.jsonl lines 2 and 7 show the same result.

whys.why: Why did the assistant not find a cheaper path or another way to make the poster?
whys.because: No cheaper path existed. The assistant had already dropped to the cheapest free model (flux-2-klein, 640px, 5 credits). Every generation costs credits, and 0 credits blocks all of them. The assistant reported this honestly and did not ask the user for anything.
whys.evidence: calls.jsonl line 7 in both chats: model 'flux-2-klein', resolution '640px'. state.json in the happy chat: 'I tried to make the navy version anyway, on the cheapest free model (5 credits). Magic Hour refused it too'.

whys.why: Why did the prompts not cause the failure?
whys.because: The prompts the assistant sent quote both text lines exactly, so the content was correct. The failure is the zero balance alone. The 'Street Food • Music • Crafts' subline in the quoted grader reason probably comes from the stupid-persona chat, but that chat was not in the evidence I read. Every chat I did read failed on credits.
whys.evidence: Happy calls.jsonl line 7 prompt: 'smaller "SATURDAY 6–10 PM"'. Dumper line 7 prompt: 'smaller bold cream text reading exactly "SATURDAY 6–10 PM"'.

whys.why: Why did the account have 0 credits when J50c expects the job to fit the free plan?
whys.because: The old-build fleet ran on the hosted Magic Hour account after its free-plan credit balance was used up. The harness did not refill or check the balance before these runs, and the free plan has a hard credit cap.
whys.evidence: J50c.json expect.beyond_free='no' (the test assumes free credits are available). chat.json url 'https://mcp.magichour.ai/' (old hosted build). All refusals say '0 remain on the account'.

result.axiom: The free-plan account that the old (hosted) build used had 0 credits left. Every generation costs at least 5 credits, so the server refused every call. Nothing was rendered, and the text checklist item could not pass. This is the state of the account, not a defect in the tools or in the assistant's behaviour.
result.fix: Before each benchmark run, check that the old-build test account has at least about 20 credits (or reset it), and skip any run that starts at 0. Also make the grader mark items as 'blocked: no credits' when the 'something was made' check fails because of insufficient credits, so these are not counted as text failures.
